messages:
Sara (partnerships): Quick read — planning our marketplace pricing and private-offer play for next quarter. Need a unified approach for committed spend tiers, partner credits, and renewal language. Thoughts?
Miguel (finance): +1. Agree we need a simple 3-tier commit structure (12/24 mo). Also need a clear discount-to-commit formula and an ROI template for renewals.
Anya (sales-eng): For SIs, we usually do heavier up-front discount + a co-sell payment. Proposal: SI enablement credit = 15% of first-year net new ARR, paid on invoice milestone.
Kevin (marketplace): Note: cloud marketplace private offers map to SKUs and a listing-level discount. We must avoid double-discounting (listing vs private). Also some clouds have minimums for marketplace private offers.
Priya (legal): Heads up — reseller clauses and auto-renew opt-in language matter. We should not promise credits that trigger clawbacks without explicit contract terms.
Sara (partnerships): Drafting a starter matrix below — please react with redlines.
```
tiers:
  - name: "Starter"
    commit: "$10k/mo"
    discount: "10%"
  - name: "Growth"
    commit: "$50k/mo"
    discount: "18%"
  - name: "Enterprise"
    commit: "$200k/mo"
    discount: "25%"
si_credit: "15% of first-year net new ARR"
marketplace_fee_adj: "subtract marketplace fee from discount calc"
renewal_uplift: "+5% unless renewed >60 days before expiry"
```
Miguel (finance): We need an example calc for unit economics. e.g., effective price per 1M tokens after discount and marketplace fee. If we don't show that, finance will push back.
Anya (sales-eng): Also add a clause for incremental usage over commit: overage tiered pricing to avoid sticker shock for customers.
Kevin (marketplace): Operational note: ask eng to pre-populate SKUs + entitlement mapping. If we want private offers live at launch, SKU mapping needs to be done before the partner listing goes live. @eng-ops ping.
marketplace-bot: New task created: MP-3412 assign SKU mapping to eng-ops
Sara (partnerships): Suggest a short playbook for negotiations: 1) baseline commit & discount, 2) SI credit/partner margin, 3) marketplace fee adjustment, 4) renewal cadence & uplift, 5) finance sign-off.
Priya (legal): Add mandatory language: credit triggers tied to invoice settlement and proof of net new ARR. Also include an audit right for credits >$100k.
Miguel (finance): I'll draft a P&L impact tab and a simple spreadsheet we can attach to proposals.
Anya (sales-eng): I'll add two SI case studies (one MSP, one system integrator) with worked examples.
Kevin (marketplace): We'll also need a compliance checklist for each cloud marketplace (tax, regional restrictions, minimum contract length).
Sara (partnerships): Can we do a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize the one-pager and assign owners? Proposed: Wed 9am PT.
Priya (legal): OK for me.
Miguel (finance): Works.
Anya (sales-eng): Works.
Kevin (marketplace): :thumbsup:
Sara (partnerships): Great — I'll iterate the doc and post a link here before EOD for final comments. Who wants to own renewal language?
Anya (sales-eng): I'll own renewal examples.
Miguel (finance): I'll own the unit economics tab.
Priya (legal): I'll own contract language redlines.
Sara (partnerships): Thanks team — goal: single one-pager + spreadsheet + SI appendix ready by end of week.
Miguel (finance): Quick note: if we offer >20% effective discount on a public SKU after marketplace fees, we need VP approval. Flagging now.
Anya (sales-eng): Noted. We'll keep >20% as escalated.
Sara (partnerships): Good catch. I'll add approval gate to the playbook.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Meeting scheduled Wed 09:00 PT (MP-3412) — invite sent to participants.
